name: Markdown Tidy API
description: The public Markdown Tidy API. Convert / clean / repair markdown into HTML, plain text, PDF, DOCX, or PNG. Authenticate with an `X-API-KEY` header — create one in your dashboard at /account/api-keys. Each successful /convert call debits 1 credit from your wallet.
